property_summary: Once an address has locked in a guess, any further lockInGuess call by that address must revert (the guard prevents overwriting); the mutant drops the guard, so a second lockInGuess succeeds and overwrites the stored guess block.
change_summary: Remove the guard that prevents overwriting an existing guess, allowing repeated lock-ins to change stored state.
